arsenal.strike.precision.Name: Precision Strike
arsenal.strike.precision.Description: One heavy shell on the beacon. Small radius, high damage. Hurts teammates.
arsenal.strike.area.Name: Area Strike
arsenal.strike.area.Description: Seven shells land within about 15 m of the beacon over a few seconds.
arsenal.strike.creeping.Name: Creeping Barrage
arsenal.strike.creeping.Description: Rows of shells walk forward from the beacon in the throw direction.
arsenal.strike.cluster.Name: Cluster Strike
arsenal.strike.cluster.Description: Many small bombs burst in a line across the beacon.
arsenal.strike.incendiary.Name: Incendiary Strike
arsenal.strike.incendiary.Description: Sets the impact zone on fire. Anyone inside keeps taking damage.
arsenal.strike.gas.Name: Gas Strike
arsenal.strike.gas.Description: A canister releases a toxic cloud that deals damage over time. Poisons teammates too.
arsenal.strike.stasis.Name: Stasis Strike
arsenal.strike.stasis.Description: A stasis device slows enemies within 8 m for 20 s. They recover once they leave the field.
arsenal.strike.beam.Name: Cutting Beam
arsenal.strike.beam.Description: A beam drops from above and chases nearby enemies for about 10 s.
arsenal.strike.hunter.Name: Hunter Strike
arsenal.strike.hunter.Description: One shell at the biggest enemy near the beacon.
arsenal.weapon.machinegun.Name: Heavy Machine Gun
arsenal.weapon.machinegun.Description: A big-magazine machine gun from the drop pod. Replaces your special weapon until it runs dry or is dropped.
arsenal.weapon.antimateriel.Name: Anti-Materiel Rifle
arsenal.weapon.antimateriel.Description: A heavy single-shot rifle with high damage and penetration. Replaces your special weapon for a while.
arsenal.weapon.grenadelauncher.Name: Grenade Launcher
arsenal.weapon.grenadelauncher.Descripti: Fires explosive grenades. Replaces your special weapon for a while.
arsenal.supply.mixed.Name: Mixed Supply Pod
arsenal.supply.mixed.Description: The drop pod delivers 2 Ammo Packs, 1 Medi Pack and 1 Tool Refill Pack.
arsenal.supply.ammo.Name: Ammo Pod
arsenal.supply.ammo.Description: The drop pod delivers 3 Ammo Packs.
arsenal.supply.medical.Name: Medical Pod
arsenal.supply.medical.Description: The drop pod delivers 2 Medi Packs and 1 Disinfect Pack.
arsenal.supply.tool.Name: Tool Pod
arsenal.supply.tool.Description: The drop pod delivers 2 Tool Refill Packs.
arsenal.supply.consumables.Name: Consumables Pod
arsenal.supply.consumables.Description: The drop pod delivers 2 C-Foam Grenades.
arsenal.turret.watch.Name: Watch Turret
arsenal.turret.watch.Description: A burst-fire sentry dropped from above. Balanced. Recalled after 180 s.
arsenal.turret.bulwark.Name: Bulwark Turret
arsenal.turret.bulwark.Description: A sniper sentry dropped from above. Long range, high damage, built for big enemies. Recalled after 180 s.
arsenal.turret.scythe.Name: Scythe Turret
arsenal.turret.scythe.Description: A shotgun sentry dropped from above. Clears swarms up close. Recalled after 180 s.
